## Complete Manager & UI Ecosystem Summary

### 1. Manager Scripts — Structure, Registration, and Patterns

The project uses a **consistent singleton + early execution order + event-driven observer pattern** across all managers.

| Manager | File | Singleton? | Execution Order | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **GameEventBus** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Core/GameEventBus.cs` | Yes | **-110** (earliest) | Central typed event bus. Systems publish C# struct events; managers subscribe via `Subscribe<T>()`/`Unsubscribe<T>()`. Events are `readonly struct` (zero-alloc). All gameplay communication routes through this bus. |
| **UIManager** | `Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIManager.cs` | Yes (`Instance`) | **-100** | Central UI relay. Routes `SignalShow`/`SignalHide`/`SignalToggle` to panels by `UIPanelId` enum. Owns a `Dictionary<UIPanelId, IUIPanel>` registry. Panels registered via serialized list or `Register()` at runtime. Events: `OnPanelShown`, `OnPanelHidden`. |
| **ResourceManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ResourceManager.cs` | Yes (`Instance`) | **-100** | In-scene hub for resource events. Publishers call `RaiseHit()`, subscribers listen via `OnResourceHit +=`. Also owns `ToolEffectivenessTable` that maps tool×resource type to damage multipliers. Both legacy `PlayerHitInfo` and new `ToolHitContext` paths. |
| **BillboardManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Managers/BillboardManager.cs` | No (per-scene GO) | **-100** | Drives billboard rotation for all registered `IBillboardTarget` objects from a single `LateUpdate` loop. Supports `Full`, `YOnly`, and `PitchOnly` modes. |
| **ShadowManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Managers/ShadowManager.cs` | No (per-scene GO) | **-90** | Manages fake shadow quads for 2.5D objects. Registers `IShadowTarget`. Currently MVP: just logs count, actual quad rendering is stubbed. |
| **AudioManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Managers/AudioManager.cs`| No | Default | Main SFX manager. Maintains pool of AudioSources. Subscribes to ~9 GameEventBus event types. Currently logs debug messages; actual AudioClip playback is stubbed. |
| **FeedbackManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Managers/FeedbackManager.cs` | No | Default | VFX feedback manager. Same subscription pattern as AudioManager. Currently logs debug; actual VFX instantiation is stubbed. |
| **PlayerInventory** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/PlayerInventory.cs` | Yes (`Instance`) | **-50** | Runtime inventory. Owns flat array of `InventorySlot` (slot 0 = wrench, 1..N = general items). Reads hotkeys (1-4). Events: `OnSlotChanged`, `OnActiveSlotChanged`. API methods use `SignalPickup`/`SignalDropOne`/`SignalDropStack` aliases. |
| **DialogueManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/NPC/Runtime/DialogueManager.cs` | — | — | NPC dialogue system. |
| **SceneLlmManager** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/NPC/Runtime/Llm/SceneLlmManager.cs`| — | — | LLM integration for NPC conversations. |
| **RobotBattery** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RobotBattery.cs` | Yes (`Instance`) | **-40** | Battery/energy system (see section 4 below). |

**Key pattern**: Managers singletons use `[DefaultExecutionOrder]` with negative values (often -100) so `Instance` is always set before any subscriber's Awake/OnEnable. Duplicate singletons are detected and self-destroy. All subscribe to `GameEventBus` for decoupled communication.

---

### 2. UI Manager System — Architecture

**UIManager** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIManager.cs`):
- Singleton `UIManager.Instance`
- Routes signals via `UIPanelId` enum — no magic strings
- Registry: `Dictionary<UIPanelId, IUIPanel>`
- Panels auto-register from serialized list in Awake, or via `Register()` at runtime
- Three inbound signal methods: `SignalShow(id)`, `SignalHide(id)`, `SignalToggle(id)`
- Two outbound events: `OnPanelShown`, `OnPanelHidden`

**UIPanelId enum** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIPanel.cs`):
```
None = 0, Hud, Inventory, Dialogue, Pause, InteractTag, ResourceHP
```
Extensible by adding new enum values.

**UI Class hierarchy**:
- **`IUIPanel`** (interface) — `PanelId`, `IsVisible`, `Show()`, `Hide()`
  - **`UIPanel`** (abstract `MonoBehaviour`, implements `IUIPanel`) — Base class. Default Show/Hide toggles GameObject. Has `OnShow()`/`OnHide()` virtual methods for overrides.
    - **`UIToolkitPanel`** (abstract, extends `UIPanel`, requires `UIDocument`) — UI Toolkit variant. Retries `Bind(VisualElement root)` from Update until the visual tree exists (defense against component ordering issues). Show/Hide toggles `display` style instead of GameObject. Has `OnBound()` callback. Manages `Root` and `Document` references.
      - **`PlayerHudPanel`** — Always-present HUD (hotbar, echo shards, battery)
      - **`InteractTagPanel`** — Mouse-following interaction prompt
      - **`ResourceHPPanel`** — World-anchored floating HP bars above resource nodes
      - **`NpcInfoHudController`** — NPC info HUD
      - **`LlmDebugWindowController`** — LLM debug window

---

### 3. Player HUD

**`PlayerHudPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Screens/PlayerHud/PlayerHudPanel.cs`):
- Extends `UIToolkitPanel` (UI Toolkit)
- Registered as `UIPanelId.Hud` — always visible
- **Data sources** (injected via Inspector):
  - `PlayerInventory _inventory` (falls back to `PlayerInventory.Instance`)
  - `IntVariable _echoShards` — echo shard counter
  - `IntVariable _battery` — 0–100 battery gauge
- **UXML elements bound** (via root.Q):
  - `Slot_0` through `Slot_3` — hotbar slots (with `hotbar-slot--active` class)
  - `Icon_0` through `Icon_3` — slot icons
  - `Count_0` through `Count_3` — stack count labels (hidden when count ≤ 1)
  - `EchoCount` — echo shard label
  - `BatteryFill` — battery fill bar (width in percent)
  - `BatteryLabel` — battery percentage text
- **Event-driven refresh**: Subscribes to `_inventory.OnSlotChanged`, `_inventory.OnActiveSlotChanged`, `_echoShards.OnChanged`, `_battery.OnChanged`, and `GameEventBus` for `CurrencyCollected`. Zero polling.
- Layout lives in `PlayerHud.uxml` / `PlayerHud.uss`

**Other UI panels**:
- **`ResourceHPPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Screens/ResourceHP/ResourceHPPanel.cs`): Pool-based floating HP bars. Subscribes to `ResourceDamaged`/`ResourceDepleted`. Projects world-space node positions to panel coordinates. Bars auto-fade after 3s display. Uses pooled `VisualElement` instances.
- **`InteractTagPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Screens/InteractTag/InteractTagPanel.cs`): Mouse-following interaction prompt. Driven by `WorldInteractTagPresenter`. Shows text label under cursor.

---

### 4. Battery / Energy System

**`RobotBattery`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RobotBattery.cs`):
- Singleton, execution order **-40**
- Owns a 0–100 `IntVariable` (shared asset with HUD)
- **Passive drain**: Configurable rate (default 1/s in inspector, overridable by `BatterySettings.passiveDrainPerSecond`)
- **Action costs** (via `BatterySettings` SO):
  - Swing: `2f`
  - Throw: `5f`
  - Grapple: `8f`
  - Pull: `3f/sec`
  - Scan: `5f/sec`
  - Restore: `5f/sec`
- **Threshold**: `lowBatteryThreshold = 20` (publishes `BatteryLow` event)
- **Key methods**: `CanSpend(float cost)`, `Spend(float cost)`, `DrainOverTime(float costPerSecond)`, `AddCharge(int)`, `Drain(int)`, `SetCharge(int)`
- **Infinite debug mode**: `BatterySettings.infiniteBatteryDebug` bypasses all costs
- **Events published**: `BatteryChanged(current, max)`, `BatteryEmpty`, `BatteryLow(current, percent)`
- **Accumulator pattern**: Uses `_accum` float to collect fractional drain, flushes to integer only when ≥1 unit accumulated (avoids per-frame integer churn)

**`BatterySettings`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/BatterySettings.cs`):
- `ScriptableObject` with `[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Flynn/Player/Battery Settings")]`
- Designers configure: passive drain toggle/rate, per-action costs, low-battery threshold, infinite debug toggle

**Usage in game systems**:
- `WrenchSwingController.DoSwing()` checks `RobotBattery.Instance.CanSpend(swingCost)` then calls `_battery.Spend(swingCost)`
- `WrenchThrowController.DoThrow()` checks `CanSpend(throwCost)` then calls `_battery.Spend(throwCost)`
- `RopeLassoController` uses `Spend(grappleCost)` on connect and `DrainOverTime(pullCostPerSecond)` while pulling

---

### 5. Swing & Throw Mechanics

**Wrench Swing (Left-click)** — `WrenchSwingController` (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingController.cs`):
- Requires `PlayerMouseAimer` component
- Cooldown: 0.1s between swings
- Requires: wrench active, not airborne (throw blocking)
- Flow: Check battery → Face aim direction → Play animation via `IPlayerVisual.ReleaseSwing()` → Play `WrenchSwingArc` VFX → `PlayerInitializer.EmitHit()` for damage routing → Publish `ToolSwingStarted` event → Spend battery
- Damage config: `WrenchConfig.lightSwingDamage` (default 1)
- Animation: Uses `IPlayerVisual` interface for sprite-sheet or procedural body

**Wrench Swing Arc VFX** — `WrenchSwingArc` (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchSwingArc.cs`):
- Two-part visual: slash line (fades) + expanding ring at endpoint
- Color: yellow-gold (`#FFE699` slash, `#FFB34D` ring)
- Time parameters: draw 0.1s, fade 0.15s, ring expand 0.1s, ring fade 0.2s
- Uses `LineRenderer` for both slash and ring

**Wrench Throw (Right-click)** — `WrenchThrowController` (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchThrowController.cs`):
- Hold right-click to charge → release to throw
- Distance scales min→max (config: 3–9 units) over 0.8s charge time
- Spawns `ThrownWrench` prefab at billboard visual center
- Per-frame: checks wrench active, not already airborne
- Battery check before throw
- **`ThrownWrench`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/ThrownWrench.cs`):
  - Three-phase state machine: `Outbound` → `Hover` → `Returning`
  - Outbound speed: 12 units/sec
  - Hover: 0.4s delay at target apex
  - Return speed: 14 units/sec (homing boomerang)
  - Catches at `CatchPoint` (billboard visual center) when within 0.6m radius
  - Spins a child visual at configurable deg/sec (720°/s default)
  - On collision with `ResourceNode`: applies damage via `TryApplyToolHit()`
  - Billboarded + spin in LateUpdate (faces camera)

**WrenchConfig** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchConfig.cs`):
- `ScriptableObject` — single data asset
- Swing: charge time, heavy threshold, cooldowns, animation speeds, damage (light 1, heavy 2)
- Throw: charge time, min/max distance, throw speed, spin speed, return delay, return speed, catch radius

**Grapple/Rope Swing (Q key)** — `RopeLassoController` (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopeLassoController.cs`):
- 511 lines — substantial system. State machine: `Idle → Firing → Swinging | PullingObject`
- Hold Q to charge → release to fire hook projectile
- Uses `RopeLassoConfig` SO for all tunable values
- Targets `RopeAnchor` (swing around point) or `RopePullable` (reel object toward player)
- Pendulum physics: WASD pumps swing, momentum preserved on release
- Blocked on mud, requires wrench active
- Line renderer for rope visual (10 segments)

---

### 6. ScriptableObject Patterns

The project extensively uses ScriptableObjects as **data-driven configuration assets** — a consistent pattern across the codebase:

| ScriptableObject | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **`BatterySettings`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/BatterySettings.cs` | Battery costs, drain rate, debug mode |
| **`WrenchConfig`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchConfig.cs` | Swing + throw damage, speed, timings |
| **`RopeLassoConfig`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopeLassoConfig.cs` | Grapple range, swing physics, pull force |
| **`ResourceNodeConfig`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ResourceNodeConfig.cs` | Resource identity, health, required tool, drops table, echo shard config |
| **`InventoryData`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/InventoryData.cs` | Default item loadout (copied at runtime — SO never mutated) |
| **`ItemDefinition`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/ItemDefinition.cs` | Single item identity: icon, type, stack size, world prefab, currency target |
| **`IntVariable`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Common/IntVariable.cs` | **Runtime variable pattern** (Architect-style). `[NonSerialized]` runtime value with `OnChanged` event. Resets to `_initialValue` on domain reload. Used for echo shards and battery. |
| **`SpriteSortingConfigSO`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Common/SpriteSortingConfigSO.cs` | 2.5D sprite sorting axis configuration |
| **`ResourcePaletteSO`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/MapGeneration/ResourcePaletteSO.cs` | Map generation resource palette |
| **`GroundPaletteSO`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/MapGeneration/GroundPaletteSO.cs` | Map generation ground palette |
| **`FeedbackProfile`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Feedback/FeedbackProfile.cs` | VFX feedback profiles |
| **`AudioProfile`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Audio/AudioProfile.cs` | Audio clips/profiles |
| **`ToolEffectivenessTable`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/ToolEffectivenessTable.cs` | Tool×resource damage multiplier mapping |
| **`DropEntry`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Resources/DropEntry.cs` | Drop table entry (used in ResourceNodeConfig) |
| **`ScanTargetConfig`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Interactables/ScanTargetConfig.cs` | Scan target configuration |

**Key SO Pattern**: Config assets are purely read-only. For runtime mutable state, `IntVariable` uses `[NonSerialized]` + `OnEnable` reset to avoid play-session bleed. `InventoryData` is copied into a runtime array on Awake.

---

### Overall Architecture Pattern

1. **GameEventBus** (earliest, -110) provides decoupled event passing
2. **Managers** (-100 to -50) handle specific domains as singletons
3. **Controllers** (on Player) drive gameplay mechanics, check battery via `RobotBattery.Instance`
4. **ResourceNode** (on world objects) receives hits via `ResourceManager` observer or direct `TryApplyToolHit()`
5. **UIManager** (-100) routes signals to `UIToolkitPanel` subclasses that bind UXML elements
6. **HUD** reads data via `IntVariable.OnChanged` events — zero polling
7. **ScriptableObjects** keep all tunable values designer-accessible in one place

**Wrench Throw (Right-click)** — `WrenchThrowController` (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchThrowController.cs`):
- Hold right-click to charge → release to throw
- Distance scales min→max (config: 3–9 units) over 0.8s charge time

- Per-frame: checks wrench active, not already airborne
- Battery check before throw
- **`ThrownWrench`** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/ThrownWrench.cs`):
  - Three-phase state machine: `Outbound` → `Hover` → `Returning`
  - Outbound speed: 12 units/sec
  - Hover: 0.4s delay at target apex
  - Return speed: 14 units/sec (homing boomerang)
  - Catches at `CatchPoint` (billboard visual center) when within 0.6m radius
  - Spins a child visual at configurable deg/sec (720°/s default)
  - On collision with `ResourceNode`: applies damage via `TryApplyToolHit()`
  - Billboarded + spin in LateUpdate (faces camera)

**WrenchConfig** (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WrenchConfig.cs`):
- `ScriptableObject` — single data asset
- Swing: charge time, heavy threshold, cooldowns, animation speeds, damage (light 1, heavy 2)
- Throw: charge time, min/max distance, throw speed, spin speed, return delay, return speed, catch radius

**Grapple/Rope Swing (Q key)** — `RopeLassoController` (`Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopeLassoController.cs`):
- 511 lines — substantial system. State machine: `Idle → Firing → Swinging | PullingObject`
- Hold Q to charge → release to fire hook projectile
- Uses `RopeLassoConfig` SO for all tunable values
- Targets `RopeAnchor` (swing around point) or `RopePullable` (reel object toward player)
- Pendulum physics: WASD pumps swing, momentum preserved on release
- Blocked on mud, requires wrench active
- Line renderer for rope visual (10 segments)

---

The project extensively uses ScriptableObjects as **data-driven configuration assets** — a consistent pattern across the codebase:

| **`FeedbackProfile`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Feedback/FeedbackProfile.cs` | VFX feedback profiles |
| **`AudioProfile`** | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Audio/AudioProfile.cs` | Audio clips/profiles |
